_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score coil (only 4% of 12h windows move ±2) inside Anxiety band with no named breaker; HOLD is the graded base-rate call until band exit.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative silent on phase/direction (metals weakness only)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays inside ~1.5% 24h range and composite remains 39-46 through next sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Score exits Anxiety by >2 pts (fear_greed <~25 and momentum rollover toward Denial, or liquidity/flow rebound into Complacency)
